messages.subject: Error with tabsetPanel and renderUI
parts:
Hello Shiny Community !
I am having a problem in my script and I don't know if it comes from a bad use of the tabsetPanel or the renderUI. Moreover, the error disappear almost immediately and then the app works perfectly fine. I think it just a tiny tiny problem, but I have to make an app without any error message.
Here are my scripts :

ui.R :
mainPanel(
        tabsetPanel(
                    tabPanel("Sorties",
                             uiOutput("qualicontrol"),
                             tableOutput("sorties"),
                             plotOutput("map3")
                             ),
                    tabPanel(...),
                    tabPanel(...)
        )
)

server.R
function(input, output) {
output$qualicontrol <- renderUI({
      if(input$supquali2==T || length(input$supquali)>0){
        choix=list("Eigenvalues"="eig","Coordinates for the variables"="var","Contributions of the variables"="contribvar",
                   "Coordinates of the individuals"="ind","Coordinates of the supplementary categories"="qualico")
      }
      else{
        choix=list("Eigenvalues"="eig","Coordinates for the variables"="var","Contributions of the variables"="contribvar",
                   "Coordinates of the individuals"="ind")
      }
      radioButtons("out","Quelle sortie souhaitez vous visionner ?",
                    choices=choix,selected="eig",inline=T)
    })
    output$sorties=renderTable({
      print(input$out)
      if(input$out=="eig"){
        return(as.data.frame(res.PCA()$eig))
      }
      if(input$out=="ind"){
        return(as.data.frame(res.PCA()$ind$coord))
      }
      if(input$out=="var"){
        return(as.data.frame(res.PCA()$var$coord))
      }
      if(input$out=="contribvar"){
        return(as.data.frame(res.PCA()$var$contrib))
      }
      if(input$out=="qualico"){
        return(as.data.frame(res.PCA()$quali.sup$coord))
      }
    })
    output$map3=renderPlot({
      if(input$out=="eig"){
        return(barplot(res.PCA()$eig[,1],names.arg=rownames(res.PCA()$eig),las=2))
      }
      if(input$out=="ind"){
        return(NULL)
      }
      if(input$out=="var"){
        return(NULL)
      }
    })

Thank you very much for your help, you guys are great !

Pauline
